items.title: 更新 test-intent prompt 的 fixture-friendly 输出规范
items.context: 把 t07-reviewer-friendly 的 desc/type/input/expect/WHY 思路写进 prompt，但不要强制所有简单 story 都必须写 input/expect。

happy.desc: 读取 .claude/agents/test-intent.md → 包含 fixture-heavy 推荐 input/expect/WHY 格式说明

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/test-intent-prompt-fixture-friendly.json:4 — prompt verifier confirms .claude prompt includes fixture-heavy input/expect/WHY guidance | severity:info

edge.desc: 简单 story 规则仍允许只写 desc/type → prompt 不把 input/expect 设为全局硬性要求

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/test-intent-prompt-fixture-friendly.json:18 — prompt verifier confirms input/expect is not a global hard requirement | severity:info

adversarial.desc: prompt 缺少 WHY 或 fixture 映射说明 → 回归脚本失败

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/test-intent-prompt-fixture-friendly.json:33 — prompt verifier would fail if WHY/fixture mapping guidance were absent | severity:info

items.title: 同步 Codex agent 资产并防漂移
items.context: .Codex/agents 由 .claude/agents transform 生成，改完必须保持 npm run test:codex-assets 通过。

happy.desc: 运行 npm run test:codex-assets → .Codex/agents/test-intent.md 与 .claude transform 保持一致

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/test-intent-prompt-fixture-friendly.json:48 — codex-assets verifier confirms .Codex prompt matches .claude transform | severity:info

edge.desc: 检查 .Codex/agents/test-intent.md → 包含 Codex 路径语义且不出现 Claude Code isolation 文案

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/test-intent-prompt-fixture-friendly.json:63 — prompt verifier confirms Codex wording is preserved | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 如果 .Codex agent 漂移 → test:codex-assets 失败并指出 drift

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/test-intent-prompt-fixture-friendly.json:78 — codex-assets verifier would catch drift | severity:info

items.title: 补 prompt 规则回归验证与 Koala Lab 验证
items.context: 验证 prompt 包含 fixture-friendly 规范，并用 koala-lab 对新旧 prompt 做 output-level 对比。

happy.desc: 运行 prompt fixture-friendly 回归脚本 → 检测 desc/type/input/expect/WHY 规则存在

edge.desc: 运行 koala-lab prompt 对比 → 新 prompt normalizedScore 不低于旧 prompt

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/test-intent-prompt-fixture-friendly.json:108 — lab prompt comparison report exists | severity:info

adversarial.desc: prompt 误把 input/expect 写成所有 story 必填 → 回归脚本失败

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/test-intent-prompt-fixture-friendly.json:123 — verifier guards against making input/expect mandatory for every story | severity:info
